scholarships.name: Coca-Cola Scholars Program Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Current Class of 2027 seniors who plan to attend an accredited U.S. college, have a 3.0+ GPA, and meet federal-aid citizenship/residency categories. Strong leadership and service record expected.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Open now; closes 5 p.m. Eastern / 2 p.m. Pacific
scholarships.fit: Major national scholarship for students with real leadership, service, work, or school-community impact. The first stage does not require an essay, transcript, or recommendations.

scholarships.name: QuestBridge National College Match
scholarships.award: Full four-year scholarships at participating partner colleges
scholarships.eligibility: High-achieving high school seniors from low-income households; strong academics and financial need.
scholarships.fit: A high-value full-ride pathway for students with strong academic records and significant financial need. The official application portal currently says the National College Match is open.

scholarships.name: Elks Most Valuable Student Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Current high-school seniors who are U.S. citizens and will enroll full time in a four-year undergraduate program. No Elks family connection is required. Selection uses academics, leadership, and financial need.
scholarships.fit: A substantial national scholarship with local, district, state, and national stages. It is worth applying even without an Elks connection.

scholarships.name: BigFuture Scholarship: Start Your Scholarship List (Class of 2027)
scholarships.eligibility: Class of 2027 students in the U.S. with a College Board account who plan to pursue an associate or bachelor's degree. Save three scholarships in the BigFuture Scholarship Search to earn drawing entries. No essay, GPA, or test score required.
scholarships.fit: A fast, low-barrier starting step. Students from families earning under $60,000 can qualify for double entries.

scholarships.name: Yakama Nation Higher Education Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Yakama Nation Higher Education & Adult Vocational Training
scholarships.eligibility: Eligible Yakama Nation tribal members pursuing accredited postsecondary education or vocational training.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Check the official portal for the current cycle deadline
scholarships.fit: A local, tribal-run source of scholarship, advising, and career support.

scholarships.name: Jack Kent Cooke College Scholarship Program
scholarships.award: Up to $55,000 per year for undergraduate study
scholarships.eligibility: High-achieving students with financial need; generally GPA 3.5+ and household income up to $95,000.
scholarships.fit: Not open yet as of August 13. The foundation has published the upcoming opening and deadline, so students can prepare early without being told it is currently available.

scholarships.name: Sea Mar Farmworker Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Washington students who work or have worked in farm labor, or whose parent/legal guardian has; financial need required. Immigration status does not affect eligibility.
scholarships.fit: A very meaningful fit for agricultural and farmworker-connected families in the Yakima Valley.

scholarships.name: Taco Bell Foundation Live Más Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: U.S. residents ages 16-26 who are on track to enroll in, or are enrolled in, an accredited two-year, four-year, vocational, technical, or trade program. Applicants share a video or short essay about their passion; no GPA requirement.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Usually opens in October and closes in early January
scholarships.fit: A strong option for creative students and students with a real goal or passion, including students whose grades are not their strongest selling point.

scholarships.name: Point Foundation Flagship Scholarship
scholarships.award: Need-based award, renewable up to four years
scholarships.eligibility: LGBTQ+ and ally students who are at least high-school seniors, have a 3.3+ GPA, and plan full-time enrollment at an accredited nonprofit college or university. Point also has separate community-college and access programs.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Flagship usually opens in September and closes in early December
scholarships.fit: A respected national program that provides funding, leadership support, and a strong community for LGBTQ+ and ally students.

scholarships.name: American Red Cross Leaders Save Lives Scholarship Program
scholarships.award: $1,000-$2,500 scholarship drawing, plus gift cards and service hours
scholarships.eligibility: Students who organize an eligible Red Cross blood drive during the summer or winter program period and collect at least 25 pints. Scholarship drawing amount depends on the drive total.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Summer: Memorial Day-Labor Day; Winter: December 15-January 15
scholarships.fit: Good for students who want service hours, leadership experience, and a scholarship opportunity they can build with friends or a school group.

scholarships.name: Heritage University Dreamers Scholarship
scholarships.award: 100% tuition coverage for up to five years
scholarships.eligibility: Current, new, and transfer students pursuing their first bachelor's degree who are DACA recipients or undocumented students; minimum 2.75 GPA.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Check Heritage for the next application window
scholarships.fit: Toppenish-based university support that makes a nearby bachelor's degree possible for many students who cannot use federal aid.

scholarships.name: Sí Se Puede Scholarship
scholarships.organization: CAFÉ / Miguel R. Velazquez Migrant Education Foundation
scholarships.eligibility: Washington students connected to agricultural labor or the tree-fruit industry who demonstrate persistence, leadership, and community commitment.
scholarships.fit: Built around Washington's tree-fruit community—one of the most directly relevant opportunities for local students.

scholarships.name: Mollie Davis Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Yakima Rotary Trust / Yakima Valley Community Foundation
scholarships.award: Up to $10,000 a year toward a bachelor's or $4,500 a year toward an associate degree
scholarships.eligibility: Yakima County residents who are U.S. citizens and are seniors, graduates, GED holders, or current college students pursuing a first associate or bachelor's degree full time.
scholarships.fit: One of the strongest awards specifically for Yakima County students; the site will show last year's date until the new cycle is confirmed.
